evidence.quote: CCB & VCS Project Description Template CCB Version 3.0, VCS Version 4.4 16 CCB v3.0, VCS v4.4 3.8.2 Project proponents shall submit a pipeline listing request within one year of the initial crediting period start date. The requirement under section 3.8.2 of the VCS Standard v5.0 requires project proponents to submit a pipeline listing request within one year of the initial crediting period start date. However, as clarified in the document “VCS Version 5: Overview of VCS Program Updates and Effective Dates” released by Verra on 16 December 2025, this requirement is only effective for pipeline listing requests submitted on or after 1 January 2027. Therefore, this requirement is not applicable to the present project, and the project remains eligible for pipeline listing even though the submission occurs more than one year after the initial crediting period start date. 3.8.3 Project proponents shall submit an initial registration request within the timelines set out in Table 7 in the VCS Standard v5.0 As per Table 7 in the VCS Standard v5.0, AFOLU projects are required to submit the registration request within eight years from the start of the initial crediting period. The present project complies with this requirement, as the registration request will be submitted within the applicable timeline from the initial crediting period start date. Project Crediting Period Length 3.8.4 The project crediting period shall be determined as set out in Table 8 in the VCS Standard v5.0 The crediting period for the present project is 40 years, spanning 01 May 2023 to 30 April 2063. 3.8.5 Proponents of AFOLU projects shall have a credible and robust plan for managing and implementing the project over the project crediting period, including for monitoring and verifying the project’s performance.
